fonts.heading: Playfair Display, serif
fonts.body: Work Sans, Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto

rules.goldUsage: Use accentGold only for value moments: CTAs, selected states, badges, progress indicators. Do not use as a decorative border or background.
rules.blackBackgrounds: Use primaryBlack for immersive media canvases, hero sections, and editorial full-bleed imagery.
rules.beigeUsage: Use secondaryBeige for cards, feed backdrops, and information-dense surfaces.
rules.whiteUsage: Use neutralWhite for transactional forms: checkout, settings, and inputs for clarity.
